SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-14: CQL — Date/Time Operators Part 2. Test these items: Now(), On Or After precision, On Or Before precision, Same As precision, Same Or After precision, Same Or Before precision, Subtract (left DateTime, right Quantity), Time(hour, minute, second, millisecond), TimeOfDay(), Today(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 sec 9.25 Same Or After / sec 9.26 Same Or Before (intervals)
issues.evidence: No-precision interval comparisons bypass interval-bound extraction: translator emits cqlSameOrAfter(intervalString, intervalString); native C++ CompareTemporal uses ExtractTemporalOperand = interval low for BOTH operands (start-vs-start), spec requires start(left) vs end(right) (same-or-after) / end(left) vs start(right) (same-or-before). Repro: Interval[@2012-01-01, @2012-01-02] same or after Interval[@2012-01-01, @2012-01-03] -> native true (WRONG, spec false), Python null (also wrong). @2012-01-03 same or after Interval[@2012-01-01, @2012-01-04] -> native true (spec false). Precision variant 'same day or after' is correct on both engines. Probes: .temp/qa/cql14_historian/probe4.py and probe5.
issues.root_cause: _translate_same_operator no-precision branches passed raw interval strings to point-comparison UDFs; native ExtractTemporalOperand compared interval low-vs-low
issues.resolution: Extract interval bounds per CQL 1.5 §9.25/§9.26 in the no-precision same-or-before/after branches (start(left) vs end(right) / end(left) vs start(right)); serves both engines, no C++ change needed

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 sec 8.16 Time constructor: 'At least one component must be specified'
issues.evidence: Time(null) raises ValueError('Time constructor components must be Integer values') at translation (crash) while Time(null,null), Time(null,null,null,null), Date(null), DateTime(null) all evaluate to null. Repro probe: .temp/qa/cql14_historian/probe3.py TimeNullOneArg. Single null Literal hits _translate_time_pre literal-int check; multi-arg path handles static nulls.
issues.root_cause: _translate_time_pre single-arg path rejected non-int Literal, including null, before static-null handling
issues.resolution: Null Literal routes to _time_component_constructor -> null (§8.16 at-least-one-component; TimeInvalid convention)
